from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):\n    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    out = [[background for _ in row] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c, value in enumerate(row):\n            if value != background and r + 1 < len(grid):\n                out[r + 1][c] = value\n    return out\n'''
